]> 29/07/2026 7:29 Fresh Snow Overnight, Blizzard Conditions Today!.

The wintry weather is delivering at Perisher, with 8cm of fresh snow falling overnight and more on the way today! It's a blizzardy day out there today with a very high chance of further snow showers, most likely through the morning. There's westerly winds of 35 to 55 km/h on the cards early and strong gusts, before easing back to a more comfortable 20 to 30 km/h later on. Visibility will be reduced in these conditions, so please take care and rug up out there.

These strong winds will impact lift operations today, so be sure to keep an eye on the lift report for real-time updates, or download the Perisher App to stay in the loop before you head out.

Our grooming team have been hard at work, prepping 34 runs for you to enjoy, and with fresh snow on top, there'll be some lovely soft turns to be found once the wind settles.

Hopefully Mother Nature doesn't slow down and keeps delivering the goods!
